00064 Text TextFileReaderInternal::readLine() throw()
00065 {
00066     ifstream *file = (ifstream*)peer;
00067     string line;
00068     
00069     Text text;
00070     
00071     if (file && file->is_open() && !file->eof())
00072     {
00073         getline (*file,line);
00074         text = Text(line.c_str());
00075     }
00076     
00077     return text;
00078 }

00080 Text TextFileReaderInternal::readAll(Text const& lineEndings) throw()
00081 {
00082     Text text;
00083     
00084     while(isEof() == false)
00085     {
00086         text <<= readLine();
00087         
00088         if(isEof() == false && lineEndings.length() > 0)
00089             text <<= lineEndings;
00090     }
00091     
00092     return text;
00093 }

00105 bool TextFileReaderInternal::readArray(NumericalArray<char> *array) throw()
00106 {
00107     ugen_assert(array != 0);
00108     
00109     if(isEof()) return false;
00110     
00111     Text text = readLine();
00112     
00113     if(text != "NumericalArray<char>:v1") return false; // should reset the file position before read
00114     
00115     text = readLine(); // should be size info;
00116     int size;
00117     sscanf(text.getArray(), "size:%d", &size);
00118     
00119     NumericalArray<char> newArray = NumericalArray<char>::withSize(size);
00120     char *newArrayPtr = newArray.getArray();
00121     
00122     for(int i = 0; i < size; i++)
00123     {
00124         text = readLine();
00125         int index;
00126         int value;
00127         sscanf(text.getArray(), "[%d]=%d", &index, &value);
00128         
00129         if(index != i) return false;
00130         
00131         newArrayPtr[i] = value;
00132     }
00133     
00134     *array = newArray;
00135     return true;
00136 }
00137
